tasks.analysis: Pigments are substances that provide color to materials, and they can be derived from various natural sources, such as minerals and plants. It was once common for artists to create their own paints by mixing several pigments together. This process was time-consuming and required detailed knowledge of pigments—their chemical properties, how they interact with different media, and their durability over time.
